original_test_intent: Stress every required ConnectX-7 and BlueField-3 data port for one hour and compare per-port bandwidth and errors to the project SPEC.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Run the source `ib_read write` activity across all stated ports for one hour.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Bandwidth matches SPEC; source Machine Time is 500 minutes.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION and preserved a real Ethernet-versus-IB/command-semantics conflict.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer selects Ethernet, RoCE or InfiniBand per project and supplies peers/SPEC; execution is automatable afterward.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: All CX-7/BF3 ports, one-hour stress, source `ib_read write`, SPEC comparison; Machine Time is planning.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: One network mode, port/peer map, endpoint commands, tool version/parameters, numeric SPEC and approved coverage.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Modes are not interchangeable; omitted ports or a different duration are explicit gaps.

original_method: The exact ambiguous `ib_read write` text is preserved; it is not silently corrected.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved Ethernet, RoCE or InfiniBand benchmark for the selected project mode and verify both endpoint commands from its official manual.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Mapped CX-7/BF3 ports in the selected link mode.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Driver, firmware and benchmark version must be pinned.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA adapter documentation plus the official selected benchmark documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves the transport mode at project level without merging three distinct tests.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Per-port and one-hour coverage must be mapped.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mode, peers, commands, message/depth/concurrency and SPEC.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong flags or management-path traffic can invalidate or disrupt the run.

missing_inputs: Transport mode and full port/peer map
safety_boundaries: Do not guess variable or `-d` semantics
Do not mix IB, RoCE and Ethernet
expected_evidence: Exact endpoint commands and per-port throughput
engineer_owned_verdict: Network engineer owns mode selection and formal acceptance.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3.1 confirms Machine Time is non-normative but retains the genuine mode and command ambiguity; it does not lower the blocker to improve counts.
